sentences.text: Court No. - 71 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 14192 of 2023 Applicant :- Ram Prakash Chaturvedi And 2 Others Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Tarkeshwar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1. List revised.

2. Heard Sri Tarkeshwar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Ram Prakash Chaturvedi, Prem Shankar and Durvijay Kumar with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quash the Non-Bailable Warrant dated 20.01.2023 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sant Kabir Nagar in Criminal Case No. 20008 of 2020 (State Vs. Rameshchand and others) arising out of Ram Prakash Chaturvedi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63075809/
1 Case Crime No. 1488 / 2017, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 422 I.P.C., Police Station Mahuli, District Sant Kabir Nagar.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 20008 of 2020 (State Vs. Rameshchand and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 1488 / 2017, under Sections 420, 467, 468,
471, 422 I.P.C., Police Station Mahuli, District Sant Kabir Nagar, during the pendency of the case before this Hon'ble Court.

sentences.text:
And / or to pass such other and further order as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of Justice, otherwise the applicant shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury."
4. From the records, it transpires that the applicants have not complied with the order dated 09.09.2021 passed in Application U/S 482 No. 14154 of 2021 (Durvijay and 6 others vs. State of U.P.
and another).

sentences.text: The said order is quoted herein-below:-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.PC has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dt. 6.3.2020 as well as entire proceeding of case no.
20008 of 2020, State Vs. Avanish Kumar Tiwari and others, arising out of case crime no. 1488 of 2017, u/s 420, 467, 468, 471, 422 I.P.C. P.S. Mahuli, District Sant Kabir Nagar pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Sant Kabir Nagar.

entities.text: State Vs. Avanish Kumar Tiwari and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As per the allegations made in the FIR, it is alleged that on the basis of forged and fictitious documents, the applicants alongwith two hundred and thirty three others had taken loan from Bank to the tune of Rs. 2,42,64,244/-
Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purposes of harassment.
He has pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention, as such, charge sheet and entire proceedings be quashed.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie offence is clearly made out against the applicants and as such, charge sheet and entire proceedings cannot be quashed.
From the perusal of the material on record and looking into the fact of the case, at this stage, it can not be said that no offence is made out against the applicants.

Moreover, all the submissions made at the bar relates to the disputed question of fact,
Ram Prakash Chaturvedi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63075809/
2 which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court under Section 482 CrPC.

sentences.text:
At this stage, only prima facie case is to be seen in the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of R.P. Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, AIR 1960 SC 866,
State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 426, State of Bihar Vs. P.P. Sharma,
1992 SCC (Cri.) 192 and lastly Zandu Pharmaceutical Works Ltd. Vs. Mohd. Saraful Haq and another, (Para-10) 2005 SCC (Cri.) 283.

sentences.text: The disputed defence of the accused cannot be considered at this stage.
The prayer for quashing the charge sheet and entire proceedings is therefore refused.
However, it is directed that if the applicants appear and surrender before the court below and apply for bail, their prayer for bail be considered expeditiously in accordance with law.

With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C is finally disposed of."
5.

Learned counsel for the applicants relies upon paragraph 14 of the affidavit in compliance of the said order which reads as under:-
"14.

That earlier applicants had also filed a criminal misc. application no.14154/2021 for quashing the charge sheet as well as entire proceeding of the case and this Hon'ble Court has directed to applicants to apply for bail vide order dated 09.09.2021.

However, this order was not communicated to applicants by their counsel due to this negligence and when applicant no.1 and 3 came to Allahabad on 04.04.2023 and enquired the matter from his counsel then he told to applicants that order dated 09.09.2021 was passed by this Hon'ble Court.

A photo copy of order dated 09.09.2021 passed by this Hon'ble Court is being filed herewith and marked as Annexure No.5 to this affidavit."
6. The same does not in any manner inspire confidence and impresses the Court about it.
7. In view of the above, the petition is dismissed with a cost of Rs. 10,000/- for abuse of process of Court.
8. After this order, learned counsel for the applicants states that the present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. be dismissed as not pressed.
9. The said prayer is rejected.
